skill.name: react-doctor
skill.description: Scans React projects for correctness, performance, accessibility, design, and architecture issues. Supports changed-code checks, full diagnostics, rule explanations, and configuration updates.
skill.summary: Run structured React diagnostics, prioritize findings, and validate improvements.
skill.author: millionco

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting or ordinary rule references. Real risks remain because the skill executes an unpinned package and follows mutable remote instructions that can edit the working tree.

remediation.issue: Commands execute react-doctor from the mutable latest release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version and integrity value, then require user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: The full workflow follows remotely hosted prompts that can change after marketplace review.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed prompts locally or pin immutable content hashes and display changes before following them.

content.value_statement: React issues can hide across correctness, performance, accessibility, design, and architecture. This skill runs focused diagnostics and guides prioritized fixes with validation.
actual_capabilities: Scans changed React code and compares the diagnostic score.
Runs full-project diagnostics with file and line details.
Runs focused design, typography, interaction, accessibility, and motion checks.
Explains individual rules and their recommended configuration.
Adjusts rule, category, tag, and output-surface settings.
limitations: Requires Node.js, npx, and access to the react-doctor package.
Uses the mutable latest package version unless commands are changed.
The full triage workflow depends on remotely hosted instructions.
Diagnostic results still require developer review before applying changes.

use_cases.title: Check a feature before commit
use_cases.description: Scan changed files, review new diagnostics, and verify that the health score did not regress.

use_cases.title: Triage an existing codebase
use_cases.description: Run a full scan and prioritize correctness, security, performance, accessibility, and architecture findings.

use_cases.title: Tune team diagnostics
use_cases.description: Explain noisy rules and apply narrow configuration changes for severity, categories, tags, or reporting surfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Check my recent React changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan my changed React code. Summarize new issues by severity and tell me whether the score regressed.

prompt_templates.title: Run a focused design audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this React project for design, typography, interaction, accessibility, and motion issues. Prioritize user-impacting findings.

prompt_templates.title: Explain and configure a rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why [rule name] fired. Show the narrowest configuration change that matches [team requirement], then validate it.

prompt_templates.title: Triage the full project
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full React diagnostic review. Group root causes, propose a fix order, apply approved changes, and validate each batch.

output_examples.input: Check the React changes on my branch.
output: Two new warnings affect accessibility and list rendering.
Recommended order: restore button labels, then replace the unstable list key.

output_examples.input: Why did the no-array-index-as-key rule fire?
output_examples.output: Index keys can associate state with the wrong item after reordering. Use a stable item identifier, or disable only this rule when justified.

output: The highest-impact issue is an icon button without an accessible name.
Typography and motion findings are advisory.

best_practices: Review the exact command and package version before execution.
Fix errors before warnings, then rerun the same scope.
Use the narrowest rule configuration that satisfies the team requirement.
anti_patterns: Do not accept a score increase without reviewing changed behavior.
Do not disable entire categories to avoid one disputed rule.
Do not follow mutable remote instructions without reviewing their current contents.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports React projects that can run the react-doctor package through Node.js and npx.

faq.question: Can it scan only my changes?
faq.answer: Yes. The changed scope reports issues introduced relative to the base branch.

faq.question: Can it audit interface design?
faq.answer: Yes. Design mode focuses on composition, typography, interaction, accessibility, and motion rules.

faq.question: Can it explain a diagnostic rule?
faq.answer: Yes. It can explain the rule, its impact, and available configuration controls.

faq.question: Does it modify project files?
faq.answer: Rule commands can update doctor configuration files. The full remote workflow may also edit the working tree.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. npx may download the package, and the full workflow fetches prompts from react.doctor.
